name: prose
title: Prose
description: The body of an article or a legal page: a readable column of paragraphs, headings, lists, quotes, numbers, code, tables and figures, each a block of its own.

blocks.label: Blocks
blocks.help: The body, in order. Each block is one kind; fill only the fields that kind uses.

kind.label: Kind
kind.help: paragraph: Text. heading: Number, Text, Heading level. list: Points, Numbered. quote: Text, Who said it. stats: Numbers. code: Code, Caption. table: Caption, Column headings, Rows, First column names each row. figure: Image, Caption, Figure width.

text.label: Text
text.help: A paragraph, a heading or a quote. *Stars* for italics, **double stars** for bold; a blank line starts a new paragraph.

heading_level.label: Heading level
heading_level.help: 2 for the article's main headings, 3 for the ones under them.

ordered.label: Numbered
ordered.help: Number a list's points, when their order matters (steps).

attribution.label: Who said it
attribution.help: A quote's source: "Name · where it's from".

stats.label: Numbers
stats.help: Two or three numbers side by side, each with what it measures.

code.label: Code
code.help: Shown exactly as typed, spaces and all, in a fixed-width face.

caption.label: Caption
caption.help: Names a code block (its language or file), a table or a figure.

rows.label: Rows
rows.help: A table's rows, each with one cell per column.

row_headers.label: First column names each row
row_headers.help: Read the first cell of each row as that row's heading.

image.label: Image
image.help: A figure's image. Describe it in the alt text, or leave the alt text empty if the caption says it all and the image adds nothing.

size.label: Figure width
size.help: Wide figures break out of the column to the width of the page.

width.label: Column width
width.help: Normal is about 45rem (around 75 characters a line); narrow suits a legal page or a short note.
